package onboardinghandoff

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/readiness"
)

type IDGenerator interface{ NewID() string }
type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

type AcceptInput struct {
	StudentID      string
	IdempotencyKey string
	Request        domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest
}

// Acceptor records a bounded, non-executable handoff only after the existing
// authoritative Student snapshot and S6 resolver return an exact READY graph.
type Acceptor struct {
	Enabled   bool
	Receipts  repository.OnboardingPlanHandoffRepository
	Readiness readiness.Resolver
	IDs       IDGenerator
	Clock     Clock
}

func (acceptor Acceptor) Handle(ctx context.Context, input AcceptInput) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, bool, error) {
	if acceptor.Receipts == nil || acceptor.IDs == nil || acceptor.Clock == nil ||
		!domain.ValidLearningReadinessStudentID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	request, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest(input.Request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, err
	}
	requestHash, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestHash(input.StudentID, request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, err
	}
	existing, err := acceptor.Receipts.GetByStudentAndIdempotency(ctx, input.StudentID, input.IdempotencyKey)
	if err == nil {
		if existing.RequestHash != requestHash {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		response, responseErr := domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffResponse(existing, true)
		return response, false, responseErr
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, err
	}
	if !acceptor.Enabled {
		// A disabled capability may replay a durable exact receipt above, but it
		// must never read Student or graph state for a new request.
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled
	}
	readinessResult, err := acceptor.Readiness.Handle(ctx, readiness.ResolveInput{
		StudentID: input.StudentID,
		Request:   domain.LearningReadinessRequest{Schema: domain.LearningReadinessRequestSchema, ExpectedStateRef: &request.ExpectedStateRef},
	})
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, domain.ErrStateChanged
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, err
	}
	if readinessResult.Result == domain.LearningReadinessNotReady && readinessResult.ActivePath != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, domain.ErrActivePathExists
	}
	if readinessResult.Result != domain.LearningReadinessReady || readinessResult.Goal == nil ||
		readinessResult.StateRef != request.ExpectedStateRef || readinessResult.Executable ||
		readinessResult.ContentStatus != domain.ReadinessContentNotCreated {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, domain.ErrNotReady
	}
	// ACCEPTED records this immediately observed authoritative result. It does
	// not reserve future absence of a Student-owned active path.
	// PostgreSQL timestamptz persists microsecond precision. Normalize before
	// insertion so the first 201 and a later durable replay expose exactly the
	// same canonical timestamps.
	readinessObservedAt := acceptor.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	createdAt := acceptor.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	if createdAt.Before(readinessObservedAt) {
		createdAt = readinessObservedAt
	}
	record, err := domain.NormalizeOnboardingPlanHandoffRecord(domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{
		HandoffID: acceptor.IDs.NewID(), StudentID: input.StudentID, IdempotencyKey: input.IdempotencyKey,
		RequestHash: requestHash, StateRef: readinessResult.StateRef, DialogID: request.DialogID,
		TeacherJobID: request.TeacherJobID, Goal: *readinessResult.Goal,
		ReadinessObservedAt: readinessObservedAt, CreatedAt: createdAt,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, err
	}
	stored, created, err := acceptor.Receipts.CreateOrGetOnboardingPlanHandoff(ctx, record)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, false, err
	}
	response, err := domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffResponse(stored, !created)
	return response, created, err
}

func validUUID(input string) bool {
	return domain.ValidLearningReadinessStudentID(input)
}
